title: IOE Model Paper 2 (100 questions, 140 marks)
html:
Instructions. Same pattern as Model Paper 1: 100 questions, 140 marks, 120 minutes; Section A questions 1–60 carry 1 mark, Section B questions 61–100 carry 2 marks; a wrong answer loses 10 % of the question's marks (-0.1 or -0.2); no penalty for an unanswered question.

This paper is a little harder than Paper 1 in Section B and has different questions and numbers throughout. Constants: g=10 m s⁻², N_A=6.02\times10^{23}, R=8.314 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹.

Subject Section A (1 mark) Section B (2 marks) Questions Marks
Mathematics 1–20 61–75 35 50
Physics 21–34 76–88 27 40
Chemistry 35–48 89–96 22 30
English 49–60 97–100 16 20

Score yourself: score =\text{(1 × right in A)}+\text{(2 × right in B)}-0.1\times\text{wrong in A}-0.2\times\text{wrong in B}. Take the paper in one sitting, then use the answer key below.
